title: Limitations on compliance with section 431:20-107 and section 431:20-108.
bodyText: If section 431:20-107 or section 431:20-108 requires a greater amount of capital and surplus or deposits than that required of a title insurer prior to July 1, 1988, such title insurer shall have three years after July 1, 1988, to comply with any such increase requirement.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "July 1, 1988" substituted for "the effective date of this code" pursuant to §23G-15.

bodyHtml:
§431:20-109  Limitations on compliance with section 431:20-107 and section 431:20-108.  If section 431:20-107 or section 431:20-108 requires a greater amount of capital and surplus or deposits than that required of a title insurer prior to July 1, 1988, such title insurer shall have three years after July 1, 1988, to comply with any such increase requirement. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]

 

Revision Note

 

  "July 1, 1988" substituted for "the effective date of this code" pursuant to §23G-15.
